h1: Wix dashboard and site pages for your app
overview: Site owners need a clear place to set up your app. We build dashboard pages inside the Wix dashboard, using the Wix Design System, for settings, record tables and onboarding. We can also add site pages that appear on the live site, such as a landing page for your feature. The pages read and write your app data, handle empty states and are ready for translation.

A full set of pages with bulk actions and site pages.

faq: Will the pages match the Wix look?
Yes. We build them with the Wix Design System, the same components used in the Wix dashboard, so owners feel at home and the pages stay compatible with future Wix updates.
What is the difference between dashboard pages and site pages?
Dashboard pages are private screens where owners manage the app. Site pages are public pages on the owner's website, such as a landing page or a results page for visitors.
Do I need backend code already?
No. If your data and APIs exist, we connect to them. If not, we can add simple collections as part of the work, and the Velo and backend service covers anything larger.
Can the pages work in several languages?
Yes. All text is placed in translation files, so it can be shown in the language of the owner's dashboard. Translations themselves are separate from this service.
